item.summary: The foreign ministers of Finland, Denmark, Estonia, France and Lithuania are asking the EU for stronger action against the use of crypto-assets to evade Russia sanctions, the Finnish Ministry for Foreign Affairs said on 16 November 2026. The ministers want the EU to target crypto networks that help sustain Russia’s war economy, tighten enforcement in member states and close regulatory and supervisory gaps. The letter itself has not been published in full.
